core_insight.why_different: Meridian targets an underserved market segment (regional commercial banks) with a proactive, automated solution for covenant breach risk, whereas incumbents focus on larger banks with reactive solutions.
core_insight.if_wrong: If regional banks are content with existing manual processes or if the cost of adoption outweighs the perceived benefits of proactive monitoring, Meridian will struggle to gain traction.

raw.product_description: Meridian is a B2B SaaS tool for regional commercial banks' loan operations teams—specifically, a collateral-monitoring dashboard that tracks property, equipment, and accounts-receivable pledges across a bank's portfolio and flags covenant-breach risk before it surfaces in the quarterly review. The product ingests loan-book data from the bank's core (Fiserv, Jack Henry) and layers in external signals (property-tax delinquency, UCC filings, industry benchmarks).

founder_resources.money_available: $1.1M seed round closed three months ago, current burn $85K/month
founder_resources.relevant_skills: Banking and risk management, data integration and engineering, compliance-tech product development

raw.thesis: Meridian addresses a critical underserved need in risk management for regional commercial banks. Their innovative B2B SaaS platform provides a collateral-monitoring dashboard that proactively flags covenant-breach risk, moving beyond the industry-standard reactive quarterly reviews. This is achieved by ingesting loan-book data and layering in external signals to offer a comprehensive, real-time risk assessment. The venture targets approximately 900 regional banks in the US, a segment currently underserved by incumbent solutions designed for larger institutions, who instead rely on manual processes and spreadsheets. The founders, a team with deep experience in banking, fintech, and compliance tech, are building a growth-oriented startup with clear market signals, evidenced by signed Letters of Intent and active discovery conversations with potential customers. This venture aims to replace manual, reactive risk monitoring with an automated, proactive solution, positioning itself as an essential tool for regional banks seeking to enhance their operational efficiency and mitigate financial risks. The strongest version of this venture is the one described in the intake form, as no additional documents were provided.
things_that_must_work: Integration with bank core systems (Fiserv, Jack Henry) from a technical perspective.
Customer willingness to move from manual reviews to a proactive, automated system.

traction_signals.evidence: Two signed design-partner Letters of Intent at target $180K ACV (12-month paid pilots starting next quarter).
Four additional banks in active discovery conversations, two of which have requested security questionnaires.
Product is in private beta with one of the LOI partners running synthetic data.

raw.what_makes_this_different: Meridian's innovation lies in its proactive, automated approach to collateral monitoring, specifically designed for regional commercial banks, a segment currently reliant on manual processes or oversized incumbent solutions.
